name: buffalo_megaherd
description: Dry-season Cape buffalo super-herd: five rows of head-on buffalo in perspective (1.0/0.7/0.5/0.35/0.25); each row's horns and bosses stand above the row in front, so the top edge is a broken skyline of horns; rows narrow toward the back, so both ends step down and out, with a lone animal past a gap at each side. Tan dust #c8b58a / #e2d3b0 only behind and between the far rows, never over the horns. Anchor bottom-centre (flat bottom on y=0), footprint x -950..950, y -380..0 (drawn extent about x -790..870, y -375..0).
